visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 final portable/source-terrain views,including the1024×640 summary. Individual Istanbul Hagia Sophia:shallow lead-grey central dome on an arched-window drum;two semidomes/four smaller exedrae,polygonal east apse and west arched screen/roof turrets;large recessed brick tympana between pink/buff piers;stepped narthex/low roofs and mapped buttress/annexe masses. Four minarets occupy their own mapped positions:two broad pale western shafts,a slender pale northeast shaft and a red southeast shaft,with tapered plinths,balcony bands,pointed caps and fine finials. Lower untagged appendages/buttresses use simplified prismatic masses and estimated heights. Fine architecture and exact ground joins remain approximate.
